description: SOURCE template, not a provisionable dashboard. build-cloudwatch-dashboards.mjs expands the protected qualified canonical manifest, exact resources and native lifecycle measurement mapping. No metric names are defaulted.
notice: One current Server / managed node / enrollment only. Windows committed memory is not physical RAM utilization. Disk used is 100 minus qualified free percent.
